children: Overview
Belgium biotechnology firm's first half 2026 net loss narrowed on reduced expenses
Company posted no revenue for first half 2026, consistent with prior-year period
Expense reduction driven by workforce cuts, divestments, and cost controls
Outlook
Company projects existing cash will fund estimated expenditures into 2027
Result Drivers
WORKFORCE REDUCTION - Co said lower employee benefit expenses were due to workforce cuts implemented during 2025
DIVESTMENTS - Co said reduced operating expenses reflected strategic divestments, including disposal of R&D facility and catheter business
COST CONTROLS - Co said ongoing cost control measures and lower external service costs contributed to reduced operating expenses
